name: Expertise AI
summary: AI sales agent for B2B websites. Replaces a static chatbot with a live, RAG-grounded agent that holds buying conversations, qualifies visitors and routes them to reps or calendar slots — HubSpot-first, with visitor intelligence.
best_for: B2B software teams (especially HubSpot-first) that want a live AI sales agent to qualify website visitors, hold buying conversations and route leads to reps
skip_if: you're not running B2B demand-gen through a CRM like HubSpot, or a simpler support chatbot covers your needs at a fraction of the Business-tier cost
honest_knock: The honest catch is that you can no longer see what this costs. On 3 September 2026 the page still had a ladder: a Free Preview capped at 10 conversations, then Business at $2,000/mo, the $500 Growth tier having been withdrawn in August. By 1 October every amount was gone, the free preview with it, and all three tiers now end in 'Book a demo'. So the price is whatever the call produces, and the only public yardstick is the old $2,000 a month. It's also a RAG agent, so it's only as good as the docs you feed it: give it thin content and it can answer buyers confidently but wrong. Strong for HubSpot-centric B2B teams that are ready to buy through sales; hard to evaluate on your own.

pricing.notes: Quote-only since our October reading. Re-read 7 October 2026 on expertise.ai/pricing: the page no longer shows a single amount. Three tiers, each behind a 'Book a demo' button: Premier (Sales Agent, CX Agent and Custom Agents, 'for teams ready to move from experimentation to real, repeatable AI workflows'), Enterprise (everything in Premier plus dedicated infrastructure or a VPS, open-weight model support and private deployment options) and Unlimited (everything in Enterprise plus unlimited usage, forward-deployed engineers and data residency). The FAQ says pricing is based on your workflows, integrations, infrastructure and deployment requirements. The Free Preview is gone from the page, and so are the separately priced booking system and Expertise Assistant. Our 1 September capture still carried the old ladder; our 1 October capture had no amounts at all. The last ladder Expertise AI published itself, read 3 September 2026: Free Preview at no cost (1 AI agent, 10 conversations, up to 50 training materials); Business at $2,000/mo on both monthly and yearly billing, with conversations for websites up to 50,000 monthly visitors, up to 500 training materials, visitor intelligence, proactive live chat and 2-way sync in HubSpot, 3 playbooks, a webhook, implementation by their team, and Voice AI with 300 minutes a month and $0.25 per minute after that; Enterprise on quote. Before that, in July, there was a Growth tier at $500/mo and Business was $1,250. The booking system was free or $30/mo ($24 billed yearly) and the Expertise Assistant free or $50/mo per user ($40 billed yearly). Treat those figures as the yardstick to hold a quote against, not as a current offer.
